observation: An exhaustive independent nibble roundtrip witness establishes a common native CPU/GPU defect: right quantization indices0..15 are ANDed with0xf0 without shifting, so15of16 cannot roundtrip. These ports preserve that actual behavior for native comparison and cannot be interpreted as correct general quantized AdamW. The fixture starts with nonzero upper nibbles and checks all mutable parameters, bytes and scales across two steps. The historical unquantized Julia implementation is separately corrected. Full64threadblocks avoid the native partial-block collective hazard.
